steps.title: Buy amulet of Torture when 75hp …
steps.text: Buy amulet of Torture when 75hp if you have the money

steps.title: Use bandos OR Obsidan armour ALWAYS …
steps.text: Use bandos OR Obsidan armour ALWAYS PRAY PIETY (can use monk robes for more afk)

steps.title: Boost 9 tasks with Turael and …
steps.text: Boost 9 tasks with Turael and 10th with Nieve, do this three times so you have 180 points (if you get Black demon/fire giant/hellhoud/greaters on your first couple nieve tasks just do them)

steps.title: Do Porcine of intrest for 30 …
steps.text: Do Porcine of intrest for 30 more slayer points and block Black demon and Fire Giant when you get them

steps.title: Keep doing this task list till …
steps.text: Keep doing this task list till 85 slayer or 93 if you want to lure smokes

steps.title: 85 slayer takes around 65 hours …
steps.text: 85  slayer takes around 65 hours to get and 93 slayer around 140 hours

steps.title: Only go for 93 slayer if …
steps.text: Only go for 93 slayer if you plan on doing post 99 slayer on the main OR if you have enough gp to max already
steps.note: Use the highest master you can: Konar (75 cb), Nieve/Steve (85 cb), then Duradel (100 cb+50 Slay); switch two masters for milestone points.

steps.title: AFTER you are done with slayer, …
steps.text: AFTER you are done with slayer, Get 70 agility for a ring of endurance for luring abyssal demons and dust devils
steps.note: Hallowed Sepulchre (needs Sins of the Father) for fastest XP + profit; rooftop courses if you still need graceful.

steps.title: If stopping at 85 slayer, do …
steps.text: If stopping at 85 slayer, do Priest in Peril to get a nechryael task on your alt. Luring with a trident with high mage level and gear while being on task really speeds up the task.
